summary_en: RISO Kagaku will acquire an additional 56,889 shares of RISO Copylandia Philippines Corp. for approximately 3.2 billion yen to achieve 100% ownership, up from 52.6% as of October 2, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Full Subsidiary Status of RISO Copylandia Philippines Corp.
translation_en_brief:
RISO Kagaku Corporation decided on November 5, 2026, to acquire an additional 56,889 shares of RISO Copylandia Philippines Corp. (RCP), a consolidated subsidiary, for approximately 20.3 million US dollars (approximately 3.2 billion yen) at a conversion rate of 157.54 yen per dollar as of October 30, 2026. The acquisition will increase RISO Kagaku's ownership from 52.6% to 100%, achieving full subsidiary status. The share purchase agreement is scheduled to be executed on November 6, 2026, with settlement on November 20, 2026.

RCP was established on December 5, 2025, to take over the business of Copylandia Office Systems Corporation, a former RISO dealer in the Philippines, as part of RISO Kagaku's strategy to expand operations in the Philippine market. This transaction follows a partial acquisition of RCP shares completed on May 22, 2026. By achieving full subsidiary control, the company aims to accelerate decision-making processes within the group.

The transaction will be accounted for as a continuation of the May 22, 2026, acquisition. Goodwill of approximately 3.2 billion yen is expected to be recognized, with an amortization period of nine years beginning April 1, 2026. Of this amount, nine months of amortization (from April through December 2026) will be recorded in the third quarter. The transaction is anticipated to be reflected in RISO Kagaku's consolidated earnings forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027.
